description: This file defines a React component named PlayerBar, which provides a playback control UI with buttons for play, pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, and volume control, utilizing Material UI components and icons. It interacts with a PlayerContext to manage playback state.

methods.name: handlePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles between play and pause states by dispatching corresponding actions.

methods.name: handleSkip
methods.description: Skips to the next or previous track based on the direction parameter.

methods.name: handleVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level based on slider input.
